what: Two surprises closing generated statements: (1) apply of a lemma concluding with its own match on Result does not unify with a generated statement match on a call that does not compute, even with the discriminant given: the two matchers do not unfold; (2) grind rewrites Int.tdiv/tmod into / and % plus ifs (Init/Grind/Norm.lean:212), so lemmas with tdiv patterns never fire, and core ediv lemmas passed to grind were not instantiated either.
cause: matchers unfold only on constructor discriminants; grind normalises before e-matching
workaround: blaze_partial reads the discriminant and ok-alternative off the matcher and applies Result.partial_cases with the goal abstracted as motive; own lemmas with grind_pattern on a / b and a % b
